density_model: Boussinesq; constant density in continuity, linear variation for buoyancy
temperature_interpretation: Approximate total temperature; kinetic-energy recovery omitted from PDE. At target speeds this correction is small; near compact outlet it can approach 2 K.
buoyancy_density_approximation: 20 K range / 298.15 K = 6.7%; source uncertainty larger. Not calibrated.
convection_scheme: Bounded first-order upwind for screening. Higher-order coarse-mesh iterations did not settle and are excluded from final comparisons.
numerical_phase: Tight pressure solve after local continuity audit; earlier samples are initialization.
screening_discretization_limit: Numerical mixing depends on mesh; use refined cases to assess the effect.
